Method of Attack: Uses Windows 10's Subsystem for Linux (WSL) feature to bypass security software by running malicious operations inside the Linux shell (Bash) on Windows 10.
Requires administrator privileges to enable WSL and Developer Mode silently.
Downloads Linux file system silently from Microsoft servers to complete WSL installation.
Uses Bash CLI or Wine (Windows emulator for Linux) to execute malicious Windows commands translated through Linux and WSL.
Exploits lack of security software support for Pico processes, a new Windows process class handling WSL operations.
Attack Vector: Malware gains admin-level access to enable WSL and Developer Mode.
Exploitation of Elevation of Privilege (EoP) vulnerabilities to gain admin privileges.
Silent enabling of WSL feature and installation of Linux subsystem.
Execution of malicious commands via Bash shell or Wine emulator.
